subject: Storage for paperwork and equipment
hook: Fitted home office storage in Stone and across Staffordshire
gbp:
Fitted home office furniture for homes in Stone and across Staffordshire.

If the end of the year has you looking at a desk buried in paperwork, a printer on the floor and cables everywhere, a made-to-measure home office can give every item a proper place.

We design home office furniture around the kit you actually use: cupboards for the printer, router and shredder with cable grommets planned in, deep drawers for hanging files, adjustable shelving for lever-arch files and books, and a desk built to fit the room, from a box room to a dining-room alcove. Finishes include matt, wood-effect and painted looks, with soft-close hardware as standard.

Our process: a free, no-obligation design consultation, a measured survey and itemised quote with transparent pricing, manufacture and quality checks in our own Hanley workshop, then delivery and installation by our own team.

It suits people working from home part or full time, and anyone who wants the paperwork out of sight.

Book a consultation in the new year.
